description.value: You gain a natural weapon that takes the form of claws (slashing), fangs (piercing), or gnarled fists or a tail (bludgeoning). Your Curse Weapon deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier of its damage type. This increases to 1d8 at 5th level and 1d10 at 10th level. If you have a different unarmed strike dice, you can choose to use that for these natural weapons. You can choose this attribute multiple times, but must choose a different option each time.
